notes.title: Closing Warkestra Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders.

First, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has enjoyed the Warkestra demo since its release on November 30, 2023. Your feedback and support have helped our team learn and grow tremendously.

However, after much deliberation, we regret to inform you that we have decided to discontinue the development of Warkestra. As a result, the demo version will also be taken offline.

On September 20th, 2024, the Warkestra demo will no longer be available for download or access, and all in-game data will be deleted.

We truly appreciate your support, and we will continue working hard to bring you even better games and services in the future.

Once again, thank you for your love and interest in Warkestra.

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #4 - Hornet
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Commanders,[/h3]

Today, I will be presenting the passive skills of the final minion type you will meet in this demo version of Warkestra, the [b]Hornets[/b].

As the only flying type minion in Warkestra, the Hornets' Passive skills largely focus on [b]sleep [/b]and [b]self-destruction[/b].


[previewyoutube=bAjONRe68c8;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Double Sleep[/b]: The Hornets will be able to put [b]two enemies to sleep[/b], buying you critical time.


[previewyoutube=FJzpm5Tv8ec;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Wide Self Destruct[/b]: The range of the self-destruction attack will notably [b]increase[/b], enabling you to take out a wider array of enemies. However, this comes at the cost of a [b]decrease[/b] in the damage dealt.


Thank you for joining us on this inside look at the Hornets' skills. As we continue to design and balance the units in Warkestra, we're excited to hear your feedback and see how these tactics enhance your gameplay experiences.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #4 - Spear
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there,[/h3]

Today, we're excited to introduce the final artifact: the [b]Spear[/b]. 

The Spear, similar to the Glove, does not have any combos but can [b]pierce through enemies when charged[/b]. Just like the Glove, your [u]movement speed decreases while charging[/u] the Spear.

[previewyoutube=Nofk845NnRU;full][/previewyoutube]
The Spear pairs excellently with [b]Hornets[/b]. The more Hornets you have attacking alongside the Spear, the faster you can trigger its special effect: the lightning storm.

[previewyoutube=XVtGyZpYdp8;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you find the Spear a thrilling addition to your Warkestra arsenal. Remember that understanding the unique attributes and synergies of each weapon makes you not just a player, but a strategist. With these valuable insights, you are well-positioned to master the dynamic battlescape and lead your army to stunning victories.

Now, time to unleash the power of your Spear and create some real electrical storms on the battlefield! Keep up the spirit, and let the adventures continue in the world of Warkestra.

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #3 - Golem
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi fellow gamers,[/h3]

Today, we will look into the passive skills of the mighty Golems in Warkestra. As expected, the Golems' passive abilities are primarily centered around defense.


[b]Throw as Base Attack:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Golem's basic attack will change to a range throw. 
[*] While it compromises a bit on damage, it allows continuous ranged attacks, thus keeping enemies at bay.
[/list]
[b]Small Projection Shield:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Golem's shield can block all incoming small projectiles, fortifying its defense and providing crucial protection in battle.
[/list]
[b]Mud Transform:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Golems lose their invulnerability but in exchange, they gain a 'Mud' effect that slows down the movement speed of all surrounding enemies. 
[*] This skill is particularly effective when trying to create some space between your Golems and rushing attackers.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=2-DAmuezW-E;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for joining us as we delve deeper into the strategies and abilities of our Golem units. We are enthusiastic to hear how these tweaks to our beloved Golems enhance your gameplay and modify your tactics. As we continue to design and optimize Warkestra, stay tuned for more insights and updates. 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #3 - Glove
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there,[/h3]

Today we are thrilled to present you with the third and unique mid-range attack artifact: the [b]Glove[/b].

The Glove operates without any combo sequence but instead fires projectiles immediately. You can also charge it by holding down the left mouse button. When fully charged, you can release a [b]massive four-shot attack[/b] that can deal significant damage to enemies. However, be aware that your [u]movement speed decreases during charging[/u].

[previewyoutube=eM8B--ZeN0k;full][/previewyoutube]

The Glove pairs well with [b]Archers[/b]. The more Archers attack, the quicker you can stack and trigger its unique effect: the [b]slow-down debuff[/b].

[previewyoutube=GY6phTeHItA;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember, honing your skills and understanding how various game elements interact is key to becoming a triumphant strategist in the world of Warkestra. With the Glove artifact and your team of Archers, you're set to slow down the opposition and lead your troops to victory.

We're excited to see you put these lessons into action in the gaming arena. As you continue to progress and refine your strategies, we’re here cheering for you. Adventure onwards and share your victories with us!

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #2 - Archers
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Commanders,[/h3]

Today, let's delve into the particular passive skills of one of our most invaluable troops - the [b]Archers[/b]. Designed to deliver increased damage under specific circumstances, these skills can be the game-changers in the heat of battle.

[previewyoutube=RkY49KgZQaM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Standing Shot[/b]
[list]
[*] This skill boosts the Archers' base damage when they attack while standing still.
[*] The arrows light up with a red hue.
[/list]
[b]Charged Shot[/b]
[list]
[*] Think quality over quantity - while the attack speed might slow down, the damage of the Archers' base attack increases significantly.
[*] The Archers shoot bigger arrows.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=TeEDjCW777Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Focused Rapid Shot[/b]
[list]
[*] This transforms your Archer's Rapid Shot: while only one arrow is fired, the attack's damage gets a substantial upgrade.
[/list]
[b]Elite Archer[/b]
[list]
[*] If the number of Archers in your unit are fewer than four, the overall abilities of the Archers, including movement speed, are enhanced.
[/list]

This overview of the Archers' passive skills should equip you with the knowledge to employ them more strategically in your future battles. Remember, mastering these skills and knowing when to utilize them could very well turn the tide of battle in your favor.

May your battles be thrilling and victories sweet! Keep sharing your feedback and game experiences, and stay tuned for more updates.

Until our next deep dive, happy gaming!

notes.notes:

Today, I'm excited to introduce to you the second artifact a player can equip: the [b]Sword[/b].

The Sword artifact operates on a [b]3-step combo[/b]. If the first two attack is connected as a combo, the last attack's speed will increase.

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #3
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there,[/h3]

Today, I would like to talk about advanced voice commands.

In Warkestra, you can use attack commands in various ways. Here are some methods to make full use of these features.

These are commands to specify the [b]attack direction[/b]. Remember, all direction commands are based on the [b]player's point of view[/b], guiding your forces.

[previewyoutube=0LVyXOjhiJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

By using all the voice command techniques, you are sure to be victorious in clearing all stages of 'Warkestra'!

notes.title: Game Guide #4 - Boss Fight
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, gamers![/h3]

Today, we are going to discuss the skills used by the Guardian, the final content of the demo we launched.

The Guardian has three major attack moves other than the base attack. Check out the list below to understand the attack patterns and some recommended commands to counter the attacks.


[b]Base attack[/b]
[list]
[*] The Guardian targets the left, right, and center randomly, attacking twice.
[*] Recommended voice commands: "Attack from left", "Attack from right", "Come here", "Watch out"
[*] Recommended consumable artifact: Defensive Field
[/list]
[previewyoutube=FPy3Y6Je3fU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Big jump[/b]
[list]
[*] The Guardian performs a high jump slamming attack.

[/list]
[previewyoutube=KprilIiPgRM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]3 Stones Throw[/b]
[list]
[*] The Guardian attacks by throwing three massive stones.
[*] Recommended voice commands: "Watch out", "Come here", "Follow me"

[/list]
[previewyoutube=Yan0T1A4zUM;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] The Guardian performs a random-direction dash attack three times.

notes.title: Game Guide #3 - Efficient Voice Command Tips
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Commanders.[/h3]

Today, I plan to explain a method that can help you conduct battles more efficiently using voice commands.

This is a feature that allows you to specify the number of minions using a skill. Each of the active skills of your troops can be used by specifying the number of minions who can make use of them.

As each type of troop has unique skills, you do not need to specify who needs to use the skill.

You can simplify the command like this: 


[b]Warrior (Skill: Jump Strike, Taunt)[/b]
[list]
[*] If you want two Warriors to use jump strike to Archers, you can say, "[b]Two jump to Archers[/b]" 
[*] To get only one Warrior to taunt, say, "[b]One taunt![/b]"
[/list]
[previewyoutube=HVzEoQ-fFwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Archer (Skill: Ice Arrow)[/b]
[list]
[*] "Two Archers use ice arrow to Warriors" can be shortened to "[b]Two ice to Warriors[/b]"
[/list]
[previewyoutube=LoBGwhwTJOM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Golem (Skill: Throw, Shield, Transform)[/b]
[list]
[*] Say "[b]Four, throw to Archers.[/b]" to get four Golems to use the throw skill to Archers.
[*] "[b]One shield.[/b]" will command one Golem to use the shield skill.
[*] Same with transform. Simply say, "[b]Two transform.[/b]"
[/list]
[previewyoutube=A3ke-F4_7vo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hornet (Skill: Self-destruction, Sleep)[/b]
[list]
[*] The Hornet's Self-destruction skill is the only skill that requires specifying the number of minions. Since the Hornets disappear after using the Self-desctruction skill, [b][u]specifying a number is mandatory[/u][/b] to prevent accidents. Try saying, "[b]One self-destruction to Archers.[/b]"
[*] For the Sleep skill, you can say, "[b]One sleep to warrior.[/b]"
[/list]
[previewyoutube=0IipOxSi5Ak;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope these tips enhance your battle strategies and help you effectively use voice commands. Practice these simplified versions and see how they can change the tide of battle in your favor.

Until next time, happy gaming!

notes.title: Game Guide #1 - The Voice Input System in Warkestra
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Today, we thought it would be helpful to explain the[b] voice input methods[/b] used in, our voice and intention recognition game, [b]Warkestra[/b].

Voice input is a crucial aspect of [b]Warkestra[/b], and there are two input methods for this.

First, we have the walkie-talkie style, which is the default method. Here, you can communicate by pressing and holding the [b]left Shift key[/b] while speaking, similar to using a walkie-talkie. Once the Shift key is released, the command is processed instantly. This is a speedy method which helps avoid any unnecessary noise or unwanted input, and hence, we've set it as default.

The second method is an '[b]Always[/b]' mode. While you're playing the game, our AI continuously checks for your voice and automatically catches and recognizes in-game commands. This method is convenient as it eliminates constant key pressing, however, it may not match the speed and accuracy of the walkie-talkie method due to continuous sound input. Despite this, if you are enjoying [b]Warkestra[/b] in a quiet setting, this method is highly recommended!

You can find the input methods on the 'Settings' screen.

[img]https://oopy.lazyrockets.com/api/v2/notion/image?src=https%3A%2F%2Fprod-files-secure.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com%2F322d1bb5-d326-4bd2-9602-68c000609303%2F8d4f591d-a92a-4a1e-b8b7-414a31e6d663%2FUntitled.png&blockId=748db102-3cf5-4349-b840-dca1cace449d[/img]

We encourage all our players to choose the method that best suits their play style and preference and enjoy [b]Warkestra[/b] to its fullest!

Thank you!

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

Today, I'm going to introduce the passive skills of the [b]Warkestra[/b]'s minions for the first time. These passive skills were designed with the aim of modifying the functions of the minions' skills for different applications. Among the many specialized skills, today we're going to focus on those of the [b]Warriors[/b].


[b]Slowing Jump Strike[/b]
Enemies' movement speed will decrease when affected by the Jump Strike skill.
[previewyoutube=KnRvXo3K7pw;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Focus Taunt[/b]
The range of the skill will be smaller, but the Warriors' defense increases.
[previewyoutube=8bX2suoeTng;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Interfering Taunt[/b]
Enemies within the taunt range will not be able to use skills.
[previewyoutube=8bX2suoeTng;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Gathering Taunt[/b]
Enemies within the taunt range will gather at the center.
[previewyoutube=cKGvBQLVbQg;full][/previewyoutube]


Remember, if you're getting stuck on a tough stage, don't lose heart! Experiment with different skills, mix and match them, and you're sure to come up with a winning combination perfect for that stage.

Keep having fun!

notes.title: Skill Command Introduction #2
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome back![/h3]

Today, we continue with part two of our skill command introduction. We're going to explore the higher-level minions, the [b]Golem [/b]and the [b]Hornet[/b].

First up, meet the [b]Golem[/b]. This minion excels in defense, using its powerful [b]Shield skill[/b] to protect allies. It can also Morph into a rock attaining invincibility through the [b]Transform skill[/b] or hurl a rock to make a ranged attack with the [b]Throw Stone skill[/b]. You can also trigger the Shield with various words that mean defense, like "Defense" or "Guard Area". Similarly, "Change" or "Polymorph" can activate the Transform skill and the Throw Stone skill can be activated by simply saying "Throw".

[previewyoutube=T8C9oQybO5U;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Q4V49qRbRls;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=CSXai3rXzeA;full][/previewyoutube]
Next, we've got the [b]Hornet[/b], an airborne unit immune to ground-based melee attacks. This sly minion boasts the [b]Sleep skill[/b], which puts opponents to sleep, the [b]Homing Missile skill[/b] which operates automatically, and the [b]Self-Destruction skill[/b], delivering massive damage at the cost of its own existence.

[previewyoutube=7qO6qOCiF2w;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=86dipY6w2V0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=lG-kNEVFQjk;full][/previewyoutube]
Ready to level up your command game with these high-level minions? 

Brace for some serious action!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #1 - Mace
notes.notes:
[h3]Good day, gamers![/h3]

Let's talk about artifacts that players can equip and use in [b]Warkestra[/b]. 

Let's kick this off with the [b]Mace[/b]! As you navigate through the stages, you can discover these artifacts in treasure chests. You can only equip one weapon-type artifact at a time, so when a new one appears, choose wisely based on your troop composition and your own playstyle preferences.

The Mace comes with a basic [b]2-hit combo attack[/b] and also offers an additional [b]jump slam attack[/b].

[previewyoutube=KLlWJ2-FhK8;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, each weapon-type artifact has a unique synergy with certain minions. In the case of the Mace, if you attack repeatedly with the [b]Golems[/b], you can stun your target as a special effect.

[previewyoutube=u9QcD9Reqgs;full][/previewyoutube]
Ready to explore these artifacts? 
Let the adventure begin!

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello there![/h3]

Today, we're going to delve into some advanced voice commands. First up is the "[b]Come here[/b]" command. You could also use other phrases with the same meaning like "[b]Over here[/b]".

This command brings your minions to where your player stands, and once they arrive, they assume a defensive stance, ready to automatically attack any viable enemies. You can also use this command selectively for specific types of troops.

[previewyoutube=Bi1UwLR5g2A;full][/previewyoutube]

Next up is the "Help me!" command. In the heat of the battlefield, nothing is off-limits, including the player character coming under direct attack. That's when you call out "Help me!", and all your minions will spring into action to deal with the situation as best as they can.

[previewyoutube=c3tXYL7JUyc;full][/previewyoutube]

Lastly, we have "Watch out!", perfect for when enemies use area attacks to take on numerous minions at once. This is when danger zones, indicated in red, appear. On cue with your "[b]Watch out![/b]" command, your minions realize the jeopardy they are in and swiftly evade these danger zones. In addition to "Watch out", you can also use commands like "[b]Avoid[/b]" or "[b]Evade[/b]".

[previewyoutube=fXiN7bB8qlc;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready to upscale your game with these advanced voice commands? 

Let's conquer the battlefield together!

notes.title: Skill Command Introduction #1
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, everyone![/h3]

Today, we'd love to introduce you to the skill commands in [b]Warkestra[/b]. You'll likely be using these quite a bit. Let's take a look at all the minions one by one.

First up, we have the [b]Warrior[/b]. 
Our trusty warrior possesses two impressive skills: the [b]Jump Strike[/b] capable of powerfully attacking an area, and the [b]Taunt[/b] skill which effectively draws the enemy's attention. You can also launch the Jump Strike with a short command like "Jump", and trigger the Taunt function by saying "Provoke".

[previewyoutube=t8FIrrplQ4U;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=xX06LfTpRNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Next, meet the [b]Archer[/b]. 
This nimble minion comes equipped with the [b]Ice Arrow[/b] skill that slows down the adversary's movement and the [b]Rapid Arrow[/b], which comes firing even without specific commands. The neat thing about the Ice Arrow skill? You can also trigger it with the command "Slow".

[previewyoutube=KUUFlNsoxtA;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2joI7TyoQ54;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready to add these skills to your arsenal?

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #1
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today, we're introducing one of the most fundamental voice commands in [b]Warkestra[/b]. It's likely a basic action that you'll find in many games: the classic "[b]Attack[/b]". By simply giving the voice command "[b]Attack[/b]", all your minions jump into action.


Using intent analysis, [b]Warkestra[/b] can recognize synonymous verbal commands intended for "Attack", adding another dimension to the gameplay.
[previewyoutube=C8jUInN_wPY;full][/previewyoutube]

You can specify a target by indicating the color or type of the enemy unit.
[previewyoutube=oiU-YeMvGMA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Jump in and discover the power of command in [b]Warkestra[/b]![/h3]
